integrity: Exact all-size proof by rank transform, diagonal projection, determinant top monomial and modulo-four valuation; direct and independent computations checked through size five. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Binary matrices with the complete zero-diagonal condition only; sharp least Walsh coefficient beyond dimension five is not proved; possible unindexed equivalent prior statement.
title: Uniform dyadic nonvanishing of the Walsh spectrum of binary matrix derangements
